The tower the largest steel structure ever built to support a launch vehicle. It must survive the acoustic, thermal, and blast environment of the most powerful rocket in the world at liftoff, absorb the loads of catching a returning booster, and then be ready to do it again within days. As the Structural Engineer on the Tower team, you will own the structural integrity of these structures from concept through fabrication, erection, activation, and launch operations. You will work hand in hand with the mechanical, mechanisms, fluids, and analysis engineers on the team to ensure the structure meets requirements for both the design and the manufacturing and integration processes. You will own the full customer program management lifecycle, lead a growing team of Mission Managers, Contracts Managers, and National Security Specialists and serve as the senior escalation point for all programmatic and contractual matters across the portfolio. This is an operator role. You will be in the details — driving manifest planning, navigating classified program requirements, enforcing statement-of-work discipline, and ensuring Varda delivers on every commitment to every customer. You will also be a builder, developing the processes, team structure, and cross-functional relationships that allow Mission Management to scale as our launch cadence grows. This role reports to senior leadership and partners closely with Engineering, Sales, Regulatory, and Legal. Import/export compliance and national security security operations also fall within the Mission Management organization. What You'll Do Mission Portfolio Leadership Own Varda’s manifest, defining what missions Varda will fly each year by deconflicting priorities across internal pharma objectives; existing testbed customer requirements; engineering roadmaps; business development efforts; and launch and landing site availability. jobs.title: Director of Business Development & Capture - Advanced Concepts
jobs.location_raw: El Segundo, California, United States; Washington, District of Columbia, United States
jobs.description_text: About This Role Varda has built a commercially proven, high-cadence spacecraft and reentry capability. The next step is to bring that capability to bear on national security missions that don't yet have a program of record, missions that require new concepts of operation, new mission architectures, and new ways of contracting with a commercial provider. As Director of Business Development & Capture – Advanced Concepts , you will own the strategy and execution for adapting Varda's commercial capabilities to emerging and non-traditional government missions. This is a senior, individual-accountability role: you will be responsible for a portfolio of advanced-concept pursuits from first customer conversation through award, and you will be the voice of the classified and special-access customer inside Varda. You will work directly with Varda's executive team, engineering leadership, and program managers to shape mission concepts, define the business case, and close. You will be expected to operate independently in the classified environment, to understand where the customer's problem set is heading before a solicitation exists, and to position Varda to win. This is a full-time position located in Washington, DC, or El Segundo, CA. Significant time in both locations is expected regardless of home office. jobs.title: Director of Business Development, Indo-Pacific Defense Strategy
jobs.description_text: About Varda Varda Space Industries builds the infrastructure for manufacturing and operations in orbit. Our customers range from pharmaceutical companies creating breakthrough products in microgravity to the Department of Defense, which leverages our Hypersonic and Reentry Testbeds and Targets to validate missile defense systems for domestic and international partners. We provide Reentry Targets that test and validate missile defense systems for the U.S. and allied nations, and we invite private and international industry partners, research institutions, and allied nations conducting advanced R&D to leverage our orbital and suborbital target offerings. The Role As Director of Indo-Pacific Defense Strategy & Business Development, you will be the architect of Varda's presence across the Indo-Pacific theater — the first person in this seat, defining what it becomes. Based in Honolulu, you will serve as the primary interface between Varda and the commands, agencies, and allied nations within the USPACOM Area of Responsibility. This is a builder role. You will drive engagement from first conversation to signed contract — with PACFLT, USARPAC, PACAF, SPACEFOR-PACOM, and MARFORPAC on the domestic side, and with Japan, South Korea, Australia, and other Pacific Rim allies on the international side. jobs.title: Head of People Partnership
jobs.description_text: About This Role Varda has grown to about 300 people and with significant growth ahead we are hiring our first dedicated people partner. jobs.title: Industrial and Personnel Security Manager
jobs.description_text: Industrial and Personnel Security Manager | Varda Space Industries About the Role Varda is manufacturing medicines in orbit and flying government missions that bring hardware back through hypersonic reentry. It’s some of the most ambitious work happening anywhere, and it only happens if the people, facilities, information, and hardware behind it are protected. That’s the job. You would be the one who makes Varda’s security program real. As the Industrial and Personnel Security Manager, you will own the day-to-day execution of our industrial security compliance and personnel security programs. This is a builder’s role, not a maintenance role. You’ll design practical processes, keep the program inspection-ready, and work shoulder to shoulder with HR, IT, Legal, Engineering, Mission Management, and Business Development, from the first customer conversation through launch and recovery. You’ll report directly to the Director of Security, who is also our Facility Security Officer (FSO), and support industrial and personnel security activities as assigned. With designation and completion of required training, you may serve as Alternate FSO, a real path to expanded responsibility. The Director retains primary FSO authority, program oversight, and required certifications. Special program personnel security and COMSEC duties apply as customer requirements are established. jobs.title: Materials and Process Engineer II
jobs.description_text: About This Role As a Materials and Process Engineer II at Varda, you will have the opportunity to apply your materials science fundamentals to the special processes that protect and build our reentry vehicles. This role supports the development, qualification, and control of processes for flight hardware, including ablative and thermal protection systems (TPS), coatings, polymers, composites, adhesives, wet chemical processing, and metallic structures. The Materials and Process Engineer II designs experiments and pathfinder hardware, characterizes materials through mechanical, thermal, chemical, and microstructural testing, and uses statistics to define robust process windows. Materials and Process Engineers are a vital part of helping Varda build flight hardware consistently and at increasing cadence. jobs.title: Principal Manufacturing Engineer (Thermal Protection Systems)
jobs.description_text: About This Role As the Principal Manufacturing Engineer - Thermal Protection System (TPS) at Varda, you will own the manufacturing processes for the ablative and insulative materials that protect our reentry capsules during the most demanding phase of the mission- reentry. TPS manufacturing is one of the most technically specialized disciplines in aerospace, requiring deep expertise in ablative material processing, bonding, tiling, and surface preparation. You will develop and maintain the processes that ensure every capsule's heatshield is built to survive reentry conditions, working at the frontier of materials science and production engineering. This role owns the development, qualification, and control of processes for flight hardware, including ablative and thermal protection systems (TPS), coatings, polymers, composites, adhesives, wet chemical processing, corrosion control, and metallic structures. The Senior Materials and Process Engineer authors the specifications, process qualification records, and control plans that Varda and its suppliers build to, leads RCCAs, MRB, and failure investigations for material and process non-conformances, and uses statistical methods to define process windows and acceptance criteria. You will make sound decisions quickly without established infrastructure, influence material decisions across teams, and mentor and help hire engineers. Materials and Process Engineers are a vital part of increasing Varda's build cadence, working directly with design engineers, technicians, and suppliers across the full range of materials and processes required to manufacture our vehicles. The focus of the job is to drive incremental improvement in the quality and repeatability of every vehicle Varda produces. Manage both rapid R&D test setups and long-term test infrastructure improvements. Test infrastructure achieves >99% uptime and predictable performance. jobs.description_text: About this Role As a Senior Payload Systems Integration & Test Engineer at Varda, you will own the end-to-end mission success for a diverse portfolio of payloads, including both internally designed payloads and hosted customer payloads. Example payloads may include inertial, RF, or optical sensors or communication systems, as well as various types of pharmaceutical processing equipment and instrumentation. You will serve as the technical bridge between each payload and the Varda vehicle, defining interfaces, planning and executing integration and test campaigns, coordinating in-orbit operations, and ensuring safe recovery of payload data and hardware. When payloads require special accommodations or vehicle modifications, you will work across the vehicle engineering team to scope and implement these changes. This role is ideal for system-minded engineers with broad cross-disciplinary background, looking to do both concept synthesis as well as hands-on integration and test. jobs.title: Senior Propulsion Engineer- Components
jobs.description_text: About This Role Varda is hiring an experienced Senior Propulsion Engineer- Components to join the team that designs, builds, tests, and flies the fluid components on the W-Series satellite bus and future vehicles. The W-Series satellite incorporates a high-test hydrogen peroxide (HTP) and hydrocarbon bipropellant propulsion system with high-pressure inert gas pressurization and cold-gas attitude control. The component portfolio spans each of these fluid subsystems and includes solenoid control valves, check valves, relief valves, burst disks, fluid filters, regulators, manually operated service valves, machined fluid manifolds, and instrumentation including pressure transducers and RTDs. A successful candidate will take on a significant share of the component ownership for these mission-critical hardware articles as responsible engineer, helping expand component capabilities, improve reliability, and increase flight cadence. Many current Varda components are purchased parts, and you will be a primary technical interface to our suppliers. Varda also intends to bring more component design in-house for current and future vehicles, and you will help lead that transition: shaping make-versus-buy decisions, executing detailed design, and standing up the capabilities to develop, qualify, produce, acceptance test, and fly Varda-owned parts. This role requires a strong sense of ownership over your hardware, continually setting new standards for testing RF components before flight. We stress our components above and beyond the levels it should expect to see in flight and we investigate our failures thoroughly. Internships are full-time and on-site in Los Angeles, CA. To be considered for this internship, candidates must be actively enrolled in an accredited undergraduate or graduate degree program. As a part of the Thermal team you will get to work on the vehicle thermal analysis model to generate temperature predictions for our tests and missions. There may also be opportunities to run tests to verify our model predictions, create tools to help post-processing data, and design thermal hardware for the flight vehicle. Internships at Varda are optimal for students looking to grow technically and professionally while working on impactful projects critical to the company’s success. You will be working on a collaborative team in a startup environment while being able to learn from some of most accomplished and experienced aerospace professionals in the world. We’re dedicated to providing an experience that will let your decisions and contributions help drive Varda’s success. jobs.title: Thermal Hardware and Test Engineer II
jobs.description_text: About this Role As the Thermal Hardware and Test Engineer II , you will be responsible for hardware design, build, and test for ground and spacecraft thermal and fluid systems. This is a hands-on role, spanning mechanical, electrical, fluid, and control disciplines with opportunities to innovate at every stage: concept, fabrication, instrumentation, and commissioning. You will be responsible for developing active and passive thermal control systems, such as heat pipes, pumped fluid loops, thermal switches, etc. as well as the supporting infrastructure for testing and data-processing. Day-to-day responsibilities will be focused in thermomechanical hardware and system sizing, CAD design, fabrication, testing, instrumentation, and troubleshooting. Successful candidates thrive on solving hard problems, adapting to dynamic requirements, and collaborating across multiple domains. You will gain significant ownership, see your contributions rapidly come to life, and help us uphold the highest standards of performance, reliability, and safety in our hardware. If expanding the capability of in-orbit manufacturing to serve life-changing products to patients sounds intriguing, this role is for you. This role is open at the Eng II level, with levels determined based on candidate experience. jobs.title: Thermofluids Engineer II
jobs.description_text: About this Role As the Thermofluids Engineer II , you will be responsible for driving fluid system design for thermal management on the spacecraft through analysis, test, and validation. This role supports development and characterization of thermomechanical and fluid systems for payload, vehicle, and propulsion applications. You will be responsible for defining performance metrics, operational requirements, and hardware requirements for ground testing and flight. Day-to-day responsibilities include sizing thermofluid and system and component performance via hand calculations, simulation, and testing. Familiarity with typical thermomechanical hardware (valves, pumps, accumulators, heat exchangers, etc.), 0D and 1D fluid networks, and fluid system modeling is essential. Successful candidates thrive on solving hard problems, adapting to dynamic requirements, and collaborating across multiple domains. You will gain significant ownership, see your contributions rapidly come to life. Responsibilities Develop active thermal control systems for vehicle and payload thermal management Develop fluid network models to interface with top level vehicle thermal model Define hardware and operational requirements for fluid systems based on analysis and testing Inform manufacturing and integration of thermal/fluid hardware onto the vehicle Work collaboratively with other spacecraft disciplines (payload, mechanical, software, propulsion) to design and develop thermal/fluid systems to meet vehi

jobs.title: University Recruiter
jobs.description_text: About This Role Varda is looking for a University Recruiter to help scale our growing university recruiting and internship program. This role will own approximately 50% of Varda’s university recruiting requisition load, managing candidates from application through offer while partnering closely with hiring managers across engineering and business teams. The University Relations Manager will own the remaining recruiting load alongside overall university strategy, partnerships, workforce planning, and program leadership. We’re looking for someone who is equally strong behind the recruiting desk and on campus. You should be an experienced university recruiter who can identify and assess exceptional earlycareer talent, build strong relationships with students and universities, and bring the energy and personality that gets students excited about Varda. Who You Are You’re an experienced university recruiter who genuinely enjoys being on campus and engaging with students. You have a captivating, outgoing personality and can naturally connect with people—whether you’re speaking to a room full of engineering students, working a career fair booth, meeting with a student organization, or having a one-on-one conversation with a candidate. You also know how to recruit. jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description_text: Job Description The Account Managers are responsible for working directly with our customers to ensure full, continuous satisfaction with our solutions and services are met. The Account Manager’s ultimate goals are to drive customer engagement and readiness of our solutions in times of crisis. Their engagement activities are responsible for building strong customer relationships that promote customer retention as well as ensuring customers are aware of opportunities to better complete their unified notification solutions with simple, easy-to-deploy automated crisis response tools they may not yet have. The ideal candidate will possess strong communication and organizational skills. They will need a strong technical understanding of our products’ current capabilities and the drive to find out more about our customers’ needs to ensure that our solutions are meeting their expectations to the fullest. Travel to our Baltimore HQ is required for onboarding, trainings, and other in-person team/company activities. Candidates must be located in the Baltimore, MD area and/or within driving distance to our headquarters. Additional compensation consists of sales incentives inlcuding comissions and bonuses.

jobs.title: Associate Account Manager
jobs.description_text: Company Description At Alertus, protecting people from harm is our mission and our passion. As the leader in mass notification, we are committed to providing customizable, scalable, and cost-effective solutions, as we know even a few seconds of warning can help save lives during an emergency. Our employees are integral to the company’s success and impact countless people's lives, safety, and well-being. We aim for a positive, collaborative environment that allows employees to work across departments easily and effectively. The referenced base salary range represents the low and high end of Alertus’ salary range for this position. Not all candidates will be eligible for the upper end of the salary range. Exact salary will depend on several factors, which may include the successful candidate's geographic location, skills, work experience, market conditions, education/training and other qualifications.

jobs.title: Senior UX Designer
jobs.description_text: Job Description Most design roles focus on a single feature or a specific interface. This is different. As a SeniorUX Designer here, you are a core architect of the "Whole Product" experience and the primary steward of our visual identity within our software. You won’t just be refining pixels; you will be sitting at the intersection of brand strategy, product vision, and technical feasibility. Working directly with our Product Development team, you will ensure our digital solutions are not only functional but are cohesive and easy to use. Your mission is to ensure that as our technical capabilities scale, our user experience remains intuitive, unified, and aligned with our brand. Candidates must be located within driving distance from our Baltimore HQ.

jobs.title: Technical Support Analyst II (Hardware & Field Service)
jobs.description_text: Job Description We are looking for a motivated troubleshooter to play a critical role in driving Alertus' rapid growth. Reporting to the Technical Support Manager, the Technical Support Analyst II role combines remote technical assistance with on-site deployment and hardware troubleshooting, serving as a key resource for customer project startups, field diagnostics, and hardware replacement. Our ideal candidate is a technical, versatile problem-solver with a strong desire to always provide the best and most efficient customer service. This position requires frequent travel to customer sites (up to 50%), with occasional adjustment of work hours to support project schedules. *This is an office-based role when not traveling to customer sites.

jobs.title: Account Manager Enterprise Partnerships, Alabama & Mississippi Gulf Coast
jobs.description_text: Healthcare is changing, and local medical practices are caught in the middle. They are trying to shift from a system that rewards the volume of procedures to one that rewards the quality of patient care—but navigating that shift is incredibly tough. That’s where you come in. As our Account Manager, you will be the ultimate strategic partner, business coach, and advocate for the medical practices in your portfolio. You are the day-to-day anchor of these relationships, responsible for diving into the data, identifying performance gaps, and working hand-in-hand with doctors and healthcare executives. By helping them master Value-Based Care (VBC) contracts, you directly drive financial success (shared savings) and, most importantly, measurably better health outcomes for the community. Note on Travel: On-site check-ins are key to this role. You can expect to travel in person approximately once per month to each account for 1-3 days, often as day trips (supporting accounts in Montana and Utah). Exact schedules flex based on client needs, so some months may feel lighter or heavier than others. Location Requirement: This is primarily a remote role, but candidates must live within a reasonable driving distance or have easy regional flight access to accommodate these monthly multi-day on-site account visits. jobs.title: Encounter Data Submissions Program Manager
jobs.description_text: The Manager, Clinical Data Management is responsible for the full lifecycle of our Encounter Data Submission and Reconciliation strategy, ensuring that diagnoses are accurately tracked, submitted, and accepted by payers and CMS. In this role, you’ll lead the operational and strategic work that turns clinical documentation into reliable, compliant, and financially meaningful data. You’ll collaborate across internal teams, vendors, and payers to spot gaps early, solve root causes, and continuously improve how we submit and reconcile encounter data. If you thrive at the intersection of healthcare data, process ownership, and cross-functional leadership, this role offers the chance to make a measurable difference.

jobs.title: Growth Development Representative
jobs.description_text: The Growth Development Representative (GDR) drives Aledade's cohort-driven 1:many demand motion at the account level for Core accounts. Operating as an embedded member of a regional sales pod, the GDR exercises independent judgment to own account engagement strategy across an assigned book of accounts, execute cohort sales plays in partnership with Marketing and Network Development, and lead buying-group qualification and discovery in support of opportunity creation. The role requires substantive decision-making across account prioritization, outreach strategy, stakeholder mapping, and qualification with limited day-to-day oversight, and serves as Aledade's primary entry point for commercial talent into Network Development, Marketing, and Practice Transformation. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home across US time zones. Wage Range: $24.00 - $28.85 per hour, plus monthly commission and equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

jobs.title: Learning and Development Specialist, Remote
jobs.description_text: The Specialist, L&D supports the People Team in designing and implementing high-impact learning programs. Under the leadership of an L&D Manager, the Specialist, L&D will partner with leaders, key stakeholders, and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in business units to support the design, development, implementation and management of learning programs that drive employee performance. The Specialist will leverage experience in adult learning principles to create and manage a wide range of learning interventions and support tools including elearning courses, videos, v/ILT training sessions, job aids, and intranet pages. Learning programs will focus on creating scalable and sustainable learning solutions as the company grows, and tie into critical employee processes such as performance reviews, competency frameworks, and more. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US or be based from Bethesda, MD office

jobs.title: Manager, Customer Engagement (Remote)
jobs.description_text: The Manager, Customer Engagement serves as a central architect for product Go-To-Market (GTM) execution, bridging the gap between technical product development and clinical application to maximize time-to-value. Operating with minimal oversight under the general direction of their leaders, the Manager is responsible for quarterbacking the end-to-end launch lifecycle for assigned product and program portfolios (such as Quality, Affordability, or Care Programs). This role requires a consultative and solution-oriented professional with a deep sense of curiosity to navigate ambiguous environments and make the unknown known. The Manager will actively utilize proprietary AI-driven workflow tools to scale enablement content, resolve complex roadblocks with creativity, and coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure releases are completely field- and practice-ready. Candidates should be comfortable working remotely from anywhere within the US, across all US time zones. Salary Range: $100,000 to $112,000 base + bonus + equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

jobs.title: Manager, Transformation (Remote)
jobs.description_text: The Manager of Transformation owns program management for Aledade’s AI patient engagement initiatives, especially AI-enabled scheduling outreach. You will lead the program end to end, driving practice adoption and launch readiness, managing vendors, and tracking program health through pipeline reporting and dashboards. You will also lead cross-functional workstreams that shape the AI roadmap and incubate early-stage ideas by researching the market, testing assumptions, and building business cases. This remote role reports to the VP, Strategic Planning, and suits an analytical, action-oriented self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity and with working alongside senior executives. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US or be based from Bethesda, MD office. Base salary range: $128,000 – $173,000 USD annually The range above reflects the base pay we reasonably expect to offer for this role across all U.S. locations. Where an individual offer lands within the range depends on the candidate's skills, relevant experience, qualifications, scope of the role, and internal equity. This role is eligible for an annual performance bonus/incentive and equity compensation in addition to the benefits listed below.

jobs.title: Network Development Sales Lead
jobs.description_text: As a Network Development Lead (NDL), you’ll drive Aledade’s growth by recruiting independent primary care practices into value-based care. You’ll be an empathetic, consultative expert who helps physicians understand how Aledade’s expertise, support, and technology can improve patient outcomes and practice sustainability. You’ll own an annual growth target in your core market. You’ll manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting to signed participation agreements. You’ll also partner with field teams and contribute to regional strategy.

jobs.title: Practice Transformation Specialist, Florida Panhandle
jobs.description_text: Join Aledade as a Practice Transformation Specialist (PTS) and personally make an impact on patient care. Practice Transformation Specialists are HQ’s most direct interface with providers and can glean valuable insight into our partner practice’s happiness and needs. A successful PTS is passionate about population health, and highly mission oriented around providing better care to patients while reducing costs. At Aledade, a PTS can impact the health of their community by transforming one practice at a time. Note on Travel: On-site check-ins are key. You can expect to travel in-person approximately 1x per month per practice (expected in the Florida panhandle). Exact schedules flex based on practice needs, meaning some months may be lighter or heavier than others.
